HUMAN SCALE / Body, gesture & creative attention

Guided imagery & pathworking.

Structured imaginative journeys that use a prompt, narrative or symbolic route as a focus for attention.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Guided imagery
Visualización guiada

An imaginative exercise shaped by spoken, written or self-directed prompts.

Pathworking
Recorrido simbólico guiado

An esoteric form of imaginative journey following a named symbolic route or framework.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

Guided imagery is a broad descriptive term. Pathworking is used in some esoteric schools for journeys organized around a particular symbolic framework; the source supplies its conventions.

FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Identify the script or prompt and the tradition or author.
  2. Record remembered images and sensations immediately after the session.
  3. Distinguish details supplied by the script from details added during the experience.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Submit a drawing or dated session note with the prompt cited.
  • Mark which images came from the script and which were personally experienced or added later.
